In the meantime, the order dated 21.05.2018, passed by the learned SDJM, Bhagalpur in Complaint Case No. 1731(C) of 2012, whereby cognizance of offence under Sections 323, 498A and 34 of the IPC read with Section 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act has been taken, shall remain stayed.
5. Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that petitioners are father-in-law, brother-in-law (Bhaisur), sister-in- law (Gotni) and brother-in-law (Devar) of the O.P. No. 02.
It is next submitted that whenever any dispute arises in between the husband and the wife the entire family members are implicated in a mechanical manner with general and omnibus allegations.
